entries.title: Evolving Orb Swarm in a Fitness Landscape
entries.description: Make a 3D Python simulation of hundreds of colored spheres moving over a bumpy transparent “fitness landscape” surface, where spheres randomly mutate size/color/speed, leave trails, and are periodically “selected” (brighten and replicate) if they reach high peaks while poorly adapted ones fade and disappear.

entries.title: Mutating DNA Ladder with Selective Binding
entries.description: Make a 3D Python simulation of a semi-transparent DNA double helix where base-pair bars occasionally flip color to represent mutations, floating protein-like blobs scan along the helix, selectively attach to specific color patterns, and trigger glowing pulses or strand splits when they find or fail to find correct sequences.

entries.title: Virus Cloud Invading a Cell Population
entries.description: Make a 3D Python simulation of a cluster of semi-transparent cells (spheres) in a box with small spiky virus particles that collide, inject glowing genetic material, cause infected cells to change color and spawn mutated virus variants, while an immunity field selectively destroys certain colors of virus.

entries.title: Bacteria Growing on a Nutrient Gradient Plate
entries.description: Make a 3D Python simulation of a flat rectangular plate with a smooth color gradient representing nutrient concentration, where tiny rod-shaped bacteria replicate, mutate their color and movement speed, and form expanding colonies, with more successful mutants clustering in high-nutrient zones and less fit ones shrinking and fading.

entries.title: Predator–Prey Selection in a 3D Habitat
entries.description: Make a 3D Python simulation of a light-colored cubic habitat with small prey spheres of varying colors and sizes and larger predator cones that chase them, where prey that survive gain offspring with slightly mutated traits, predators with successful captures replicate, and trajectories are shown with faint trails.

entries.title: Mutating Rocket Designs in a Launch Arena
entries.description: Make a 3D Python simulation of multiple simple rocket models on a flat pad that launch upward one by one, with varying fin sizes, body lengths, and colors mutating each generation, and only rockets that reach a glowing height ring are “selected” to spawn similar but slightly changed designs for the next round.
